about_the_game:
Enchanter is a roguelike dungeon crawler blending bullet hell combat with sandbox survival elements. Explore mysterious fragmented realms where you'll mine ores, unlock treasure chests, gather resources, cook meals, trade with merchants, enchant gear, and battle magical creatures. Journey through ever-changing environments - from mystical forests to treacherous caverns - to unravel the secrets and claim the ultimate treasures of these dynamic dungeons.

Key Features:

  • Streamlined Sandbox Systems: Intuitive mining, cooking, trading, and enchantment mechanics

  • Universal Enchantment: Almost everything you can obtain - from weapons to apples - can be enhanced with various common and unique enchantments

  • Massive Collection: Over 500 diverse weapons, gear, tools, food items, and artifacts to discover

  • Reimagined Bullet Hell: Our reworked projectile combat system makes the game accessible to newcomers while offering fresh challenges for bullet hell veterans through innovative dodging mechanics

  • And much more...?
